lines.text: Many learners say: He have a car.
Use has with he, she, it.
Has! She has a big house.

data.why: Use has with he, she, it.

native.tip: مع he وshe وit نستخدم has: “He has a car.” وليس “He have a car.”.
native.caption: هل تقول أحيانًا “He have a car.” 😅 مع he وshe وit نستخدم has، فالجملة الصحيحة “He has a car.” استمع إلى Ama وكرّر! تدرّب أكثر في تطبيق Lexkite.

en.hook: Do you say “He have a car”?
en.tip: With he, she and it we use has: “He has a car.” not “He have a car.”.
en.caption: Do you sometimes say “He have a car.” 😅 With he, she and it we use has, so the right sentence is “He has a car.” Listen to Ama and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
